analysis:
Examined the head text of ClusterOnboardingLive.swift (lines 890-1633) and the ClusterService.swift patch. No concrete security regression was identified.

Onboarding changes: serving-scope plumbing (planModels/adopt requests now carry `scope`; localPlanModels/localAdopt accept it). These are visible in the head text at lines 1048-1059 and 1084. The scope travels over the paired, authenticated cluster link and is used only for planning and adoption. I saw no new trust-boundary crossing. Model copy/download paths (receiveFromPeer, downloadOnThisMac, copyModel) verify the catalog digest and manifest. Those paths appear unchanged and the changed lines were not visible in this excerpt. The `localToken` is attached only for local-only serve commands, as before.

ClusterService.swift: the new `environment` init parameter defaults to nil, which falls back to ProcessInfo's environment, so production behaviour is preserved. `partEnvironment` now sets `process.environment` explicitly to the service's own environment. The only mutation redirects the heartbeat-file key to a separate part-health path, and only when the key is present and non-empty. This is an availability/liveness fix. It does not widen the environment passed to the child, since the child previously inherited the same environment. It does not touch the provider's attestation or authorization boundaries (TB-011, T-053). `ClusterApprovalCheck.setAside(by:worker:now:)` replaces the inline `.serveLocally` handling. Its body is not supplied, so whether it preserves the prior set-aside semantics is unverified. The comment now says the member-role-not-accepted-in-time end is not counted as a quick end, which changes the local-serving fallback logic. I did not verify that `ClusterApprovalCheck.memberQuickEnds` and `setAside` match this.

Open integration questions: the bodies of `ClusterApprovalCheck.setAside` and `ClusterServiceAgent.partHealthPath` (path permissions and location) were not supplied. The part-health file lives in the service directory, whose ownership and mode I could not verify.
